page.notes: The Greek glosses and lemmata are only partly legible at this scan resolution; the marked words (Δάματ, ἐφ' ἑαυτοῦ, ἐοικότα, Ἀταλ..., ὑπερβ..., ἐσθλός) are doubtful and should be checked against the original. Printed spellings kept as they appear: "Cere grade", "subsiste", "Peregrinae & ascitae". Verse references "Strophe 2. versuum 13." and "Antistrophe 2. versuum 13." are set apart as small titles.
